items.value: Yeah, I slept well after a hearty lunch. Damn it, I still haven't thanked grandma for the pancakes! I need to make that right.
Oh, sweetie pie, are you awake?
Wow, how long did I sleep? A couple of hours?
Wow, you slept until the evening! It's already getting dark! Well, you woke up just in time, let's go, you can help with something.
Oh, work again?
Oh, what, just a small thing!
I was trying to activate my Lariska, but she wouldn't do it! I told her, "Open the portal," and she kept blabbering about some command! Look at her, being so insolent to her elders!
Bah, that's not how it should be. Be more polite there, it's an elemental after all.

A unicorn, even! Sweetie Pie, help me make this thing open a portal! I need to make some potion, and all the ingredients are on the second floor. And you won't be too comfortable sleeping on the couch.
Uh... ok, ok, I'll do it now.
Okay, let's do some basic magical analysis... ah, the elemental received a new telepathic message from the Capital...
TERMS OF USE HAVE BEEN UPDATED. A CHECKOUT IS REQUIRED TO CONFIRM YOUR INTELLIGENCE LEVEL ABOVE GOBLIN. CONFIRM YOUR WILLINGNESS TO PASS THE CHECKOUT.
Ah, right, I get it. I confirm.
CONDUCTING ROOM ANALYSIS. ROOM ANALYSIS COMPLETE. CHECKOUT: RAINBOW. PASS THE CHECKOUT.
Uh... rainbow?
Yeah, I see. Thank you.
Rainbow, rainbow, rainbow... well, I can hardly summon a rainbow, I'm not a wizard, and I don't have a level six mana cell.
Maybe it's related to the metaphorical rainbow? Or to the colors of objects? But what objects?
Well, that's it, I think... right?
CONTROL COMMAND PASSED. HUMAN-LEVEL INTELLIGENCE CONFIRMED. LARISA READY FOR WORK.
Lich take it, I hate elementals
MUTUALLY
What?
Ugh. I need to talk to grandma.
Bah, I'm done, the portal is working, take the job
Oh, my little darling, you're so smart! I'm so ignorant of all these new things.
Bah, Larisa was invented about a hundred years ago.

What was I talking about? My neighbors installed it about eighty years ago, and a couple of weeks ago I asked their great-grandchildren for help, but they couldn't figure it out! Oh, the lost generation...
Well, it's okay, I'm here, I'll help with everything, if anything.
Oh, what am I doing here... Go to your room and tidy it up, I haven't been there properly for ten years. But don't stay too long!
Got it. I'll be there.
